title: Prospective Randomized Evaluation of Emerging Novel Treatments for Infection prophylaxis in Total Joint Replacement (PREVENT-iT)
official: Prospective Randomized Evaluation of Emerging Novel Treatments for Infection prophylaxis in Total Joint Replacement (PREVENT-iT)
summary:
Main objective: To determine in patients undergoing primary or aseptic revision TJR if: 
1. A 0.35% PI irrigation solution compared to a normal saline irrigation solution reduces the risk of reoperation due to infection within 12 months of primary or aseptic revision hip or knee TJR.
2. A 0.05% chlorhexidine irrigation solution compared to a normal saline irrigation solution reduces the risk of reoperation due to infection within 12 months of primary or aseptic revision hip or knee TJR.
3. The use of local vancomycin versus no local vancomycin reduces the risk of reoperation due to infection within 12 months of primary or aseptic revision hip or knee TJR.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients 18 years of age or older.
2. Undergoing primary or aseptic revision TJR
Exclusion criteria:
1. Received antibiotics for any reason in the two weeks prior to their TJR.
2. Prior enrollment in the trial including the pilot study.
3. Any condition or circumstance, which in the opinion of the Investigator, interferes with assessments or completion of the trial.
4. A contraindication to study interventions.
5. Chronic or acute infection at or near the TJR site.
6. Prior history of periprosthetic joint infection including any reoperation due to infection.
7. Undergoing surgery for a diagnosis of a fracture.
8. Open infected wounds on affected limb
9. Undergoing bilateral TJR.
10. Currently enrolled in a study that does not permit co-enrollment
11. Did not provide informed consent.
